in_sanskrit.name: Hemlal
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Moon god's beloved
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Hemlal एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit words ‘hema’ (moon) and ‘lalita’ (beloved), Hemlal refers to the beloved of the moon god. It is also associated with the Hindu god, Shiva, whose consort, Parvati, is referred to as Hemalata.
